decisive_spans.text: On examination, there was a verrucous, infected ulceration with infiltrated, hyperkeratotic edges and a whitish, fissured base measuring 3 cm in diameter, extending onto the dorsum of the foot

response.rationale: The description of a rapidly growing, hyperkeratotic lesion with verrucous, infected ulceration and infiltrated, hyperkeratotic edges strongly supports Keratoacanthoma. The lack of improvement with antifungal treatments contradicts fungal infections. While other conditions like pyoderma gangrenosum involve ulcers, the specific morphological description aligns best with Keratoacanthoma.
